The name was used as a war cry by the army of the Prophet (pbuh) during the Battle of Uhud, thereby serving as a symbol of unity and courage in the face of fear and adversity.

Additionally, the name Jazub can serve as a source of motivation and inspiration for those seeking to face their fears head-on and live a life of courage and faith.
